subject: MediCorp: Private deployment operator census & EU hosting anchor letter
messages:
From: Jared Lin <jared.lin@medicorp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@medicorp.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Private deployment — EU hosting confirmation + operator census ask

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. As part of our procurement checklist for a private deployment in the EU, the security team needs:

- A short anchor letter confirming physical region(s) where customer data for the private deployment will reside (EU-only commitment).
- A one-page operator census listing roles with access to the private peering/keystore (names, role, geo of operator).
- A scoped CAIQ slice (only controls relevant to private deploy + VPC peering + keystore).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide these artifacts and an estimated delivery ETA? We are on an aggressive timeline — pilot kick-off the week of May 24.

Appreciate it,

Jared Lin
CISO, MediCorp
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Lin <jared.lin@medicorp.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deployment — EU hosting confirmation + operator census ask

Hi Jared —

Confirming we can provide everything you listed. Quick plan:

1) Anchor letter: short signed PDF from our Privacy & Compliance team that affirms the private deployment will be pinned to EU regions (customer may select EU-West-1/Frankfurt or EU-West-2). We’ll include fallback guidance for disaster recovery (replication only to EU regions).

2) Operator census: we can produce a CSV extract with operator role, team, primary office region, and approved access window for keystore operations. We will redact phone numbers and internal IDs per our privacy practice.

3) CAIQ slice: scoped controls focused on network boundary, VPC peering, keystore key-split, and operator access procedures.

ETA: I’ll coordinate artifacts by EOD Friday (2027-05-14) for internal review and then send to you on Monday (2027-05-17) unless you need them sooner. If you need docs earlier for legal review, pls indicate which artifact to prioritize.

Also looping in Kim (legal touch) and Grace (ops lead) to confirm signatures and operator manifest export.

Thanks,

Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Jared Lin <jared.lin@medicorp.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deployment — EU hosting confirmation + operator census ask

Jared —

We’ll prepare the anchor letter on Redwood letterhead (signed by our Head of Compliance). For the operator census, note the export will include:

- operator_name (redacted to initials if requested),
- role (e.g., Keystore Admin / Network Operator),
- team (Platform / SRE / Secure Services),
- primary office region (EU / US / APAC),
- privileged_access_scope (keystore, peering, ops runbook),
- last_approved_date (ISO date).

We will also attach a short ops runbook excerpt describing emergency access and breakglass flow (no passwords, just flow).

On CAIQ: per your request we’ll slice out relevant control IDs and include our control narratives and evidence links. Evidence will be zipped; sensitive evidence references will be shared via secure link only (Drive with restricted viewer list).

Delivery: I’ll attach the PDF anchor and zip of the CAIQ slice to a reply by Monday 2027-05-17 17:00 UTC.

Kimberly Park
Principal Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_CA-Hosting-Statement.pdf (to follow)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Lin <jared.lin@medicorp.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 17:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deployment — EU hosting confirmation + operator census ask

Hi Jared —

Attaching the requested artifacts for your review (see attachment stubs below). Short notes:

- redwood_CA-Hosting-Statement.pdf (signed): Confirms EU-only hosting for the private deployment and describes our replication DR policy (EU to EU only).
- privatenet-operator-census.csv (CSV): contains operator role, team, office region and last_approved_date. We have redacted direct contact info.
- Redwood-CAIQ-slice-2027.zip: extracted CAIQ control narratives relevant to VPC peering, keystore split, operator access, key rotation, and logging. Evidence pointers included.

Attachments are shared via a restricted Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-Redwood-CAIQ-2027 (access granted to your jared.lin@medicorp.com and legal@medicorp.com).

If Legal needs a countersigned DPA addendum for the private deployment, please route the DocuSign link to kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com and I’ll expedite.

Next steps proposed:
- You confirm receipt and any follow-ups to the operator census (full names vs initials).
- Legal confirms DPA signature window.
- Schedule a 30-min walkthrough w/ your security ops for Tuesday 2027-05-18 if helpful.

Thanks,

Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs:
- redwood_CA-Hosting-Statement.pdf (application/pdf)
- privatenet-operator-census.csv (text/csv)
- Redwood-CAIQ-slice-2027.zip (application/zip)
